column.name: event_type
column.valueComputed: CASE WHEN (SELECT c.type FROM calendar_to_event cte JOIN calendar c ON cte.calendar_id = c.id WHERE cte.event_id = calendar_event.id) = 'USER' THEN 'VACATION'::eventtype WHEN (SELECT c.type FROM calendar_to_event cte JOIN calendar c ON cte.calendar_id = c.id WHERE cte.event_id = calendar_event.id) = 'GLOBAL' THEN 'HOLIDAY'::eventtype WHEN (SELECT c.type FROM calendar_to_event cte JOIN calendar c ON cte.calendar_id = c.id WHERE cte.event_id = calendar_event.id) = 'RESOURCE' THEN 'SERVICE'::eventtype ELSE 'VACATION'::eventtype END
